== How to get ==
* Enemies can drop Crystals
* Bosses and Minibosses drop Crystals
* Chests can contain Crystals

== Uses ==

* Permanent Upgrades at [[Vivian]]
* Spell Disable at [[Gina]]
* Set upgrading at [[Leah]]
* Crystals are also displayed in the "load game" menu
